rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when something is located or mingles within a group or collection.

example.english: Amongst a group of colleagues, Ming jokes the most.
example.traditional: 喺一班同事入面，阿明最鍾意講笑。
example.jyutping: hai2 jat1 baan1 tung4 si6 jap6 min6 aa3 ming4 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 gong2 siu3

rows.note: Use this especially when the items are distinct members of a group, such as people or objects considered separately.

example.english: Amongst friends, there is no need to fuss over these little things.
example.traditional: 喺朋友之間，呢啲小事唔使計較。
example.jyutping: hai2 pang4 jau5 zi1 gaan1 ni1 di1 siu2 si6 m4 sai2 gai3 gaau3
